known.title: The repair orders loop_sim after dev_runs only, so loop_sim and heldout_runs still write results.md with no Depends chain
known.locator: Steps, row 8 loop_sim, Depends (line 81); Steps, row 6 heldout_runs, Files and Depends (line 79); Steps, row 5 dev_runs (line 78)
known.summary: Round-1 finding 4 asks for a Depends chain between loop_sim and both benchmark steps that write .agents/skills/review-benchmark/results.md. The repair makes loop_sim (line 81) depend only on step 5 dev_runs. Step 6 heldout_runs (line 79) also depends on step 5 and also lists results.md. So steps 6 and 8 share a Files path with no Depends chain and no owner of the shared edit. plugins/plan-lifecycle/skills/productivity/plan-manager/references/plan-contract.md (lines 73-74 at repo_ref) requires one of the two. A parallel run of the two steps can overwrite the held-out tables or the LOW-rule simulation in the results log.
